capabilities: Search, sort, and filter a people directory by name, relation, tag, and other fields
Display person profiles with photos, aliases, birthdays, ages, and contact actions
Create and edit people through a guided form that writes plain Markdown and YAML
Define custom fields and relabel, reorder, or hide form fields
Mirror relation and location values to Obsidian tags for tag search and graph grouping
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs reference SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHANGELOG.md, and DEVELOPMENT.md for details kept elsewhere, and manual installation requires downloading release assets from GitHub.
motivation: The author wanted to remember people without turning the vault into a database that cannot be read: Known adds the interface while the vault remains the source of truth.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage people as structured, searchable contact profiles while keeping the underlying notes as readable Markdown.
summary: Local-first people directory that stores each contact as an ordinary Markdown note and shows a searchable directory with polished person profiles.
